Inside the bundle that dir is .../resources with no .git, so self_update.py:123-130 fell through to pip, and updates.py:422 -> :449-452 -> _apply_pip_update (:320) runs `<installer> install -U personalclaw==<tag>` against sys.executable — THE FROZEN PYINSTALLER BACKEND IN THE SHIPPED APPIMAGE/.DEB. `desktop` was a value with THREE CONSUMERS (self_update.py:73-78, UpdatesPanel.tsx:130, cli_server.py:520) AND NO PRODUCER, and every test of it set the env var itself (tests/test_self_update.py:36-38) — a test green only because the dependency was missing, which is why nothing caught it. SECOND DEFECT FOUND ON THE WAY: all three surfaces said the app "updates itself" via electron-updater, which is NOT in desktop/package.json and appears nowhere under desktop/. That copy became REACHABLE for the first time once the kind was fixed, so fixing one defect exposed the other. REMEDY IS OPEN, NOT LANDED: PR #2696 declares the kind via a new pure desktop/gatewayEnv.js (an inline literal is why the omission survived), pins it to INSTALL_KINDS, corrects the copy on all three surfaces, and adds a rail that REDS WHEN electron-updater lands so the wording is restored then.
